preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 5,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in string.ascii_letters + string.digits for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists of Latin letters and digits.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(palindrome_degree(s[:i]) for i in range(1, len(s) + 1))
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the palindrome degrees of all the string's prefixes.
